misses.counterfactual_theory: A frozen record linking each forecast's pre-outcome specification and evidence cutoff to its settled outcome could make forecast misses auditable. The supplied records do not establish that this information would have changed any decision or reduced a demonstrated miss.
misses.decision_relevance: The settlement records give forecast IDs and later target-time prices, but not the forecast contents, issuance times, or eligible evidence cutoffs needed to compare an ex-ante decision with its outcome. This supports an auditability gap, not a demonstrated decision failure.
misses.miss_description: DATA_GAP_ONLY: matured mark-price settlements are present, while the supplied registry says candidate specifications, issue/cutoff provenance, and linked scoring records are absent or incomplete. No specific prior decision miss is established.
misses.missing_history_problem: Without immutable forecast specifications and issuance/evidence-cutoff provenance linked to realized outcomes, the supplied settlements cannot establish what was forecast before the outcome or whether a forecast was missed.
misses.outcome_reference: Settlement evidence records report confirmed target-time mark prices, including EXP-FC-f9b7fcc9fbc3e09be1f5 at 79,635.7 BTC-USDT-SWAP and EXP-FC-fe4f390da43656d3bc36 at 78,393.3 BTC-USDT-SWAP. These are point outcomes, not portfolio results.
misses.proposed_metric_name: Frozen forecast specification, issuance/evidence-cutoff, and linked matured-outcome record
